name: OpenGrammar
description: I’m trying to create something similar to Grammarly. Hail to open source!

paragraphs: ✨ Open source grammar checker powered by AI ✨
features: 🎯 Real-time Grammar Checking - Advanced AI-powered grammar and spelling analysis
🎨 Style Enhancement - Writing style evaluation and suggestions
📊 Readability Metrics - Flesch-Kincaid, SMOG, and ARI scores
🔤 Smart Corrections - Context-aware suggestions with one-click fixes
📚 Synonym Suggestions - Intelligent word replacement options

whatItDoes.text: ✨ Open source grammar checker powered by AI ✨

requirements.text: > Note: You'll need a Google Gemini API key from Google AI Studio.
